stemMarkdown: 25 workers, each working 8 hours a day, can complete a job in 17 days. How many days will 23 workers, each working 8 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 25 \times 17 \times 8$ worker-hours $= 3400$. With 23 workers at 8 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{3400}{23\times8} = 18.48$.
